abstract: In operation the comparative analysis of algorithms of the solution of tasks of separation of a channel resource on the basis of the theory of complexity of computation for queuing systems on the basis of teletraffic theories and indistinct sets is carried out.

articleTitle: Geometric method for determining signal parameters of the three-point matrix simulator
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper we derive expressions for calculating the amplitudes of the signals supplied to the emitters of the matrix simulator for getting a adjusted position of the apparent center of radiation by a geometric method.

articleTitle: Using graphics processors to simulate the radar echo signals from the ground surface
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Using of modern graphics processors to calculate samples of the complex envelope of radar echo signals from the ground surface is discussed.

articleTitle: Work asynchronized converter-fed motor clean active power consumption by anchor
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article discusses the option of asynchronized converter-fed motor only active power consumption by the armature.

articleTitle: Synthesis of ferromagnetic frequency multipliers
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Features of a method of synthesis of ferromagnetic frequency multipliers of the harmonious fluctuations, connected with optimization of design data of nonlinear throttles and transformers are considered.

articleTitle: All-digital implementation of an FM modulator
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper considers digital methods of signal generation for FM radio broadcasting using direct digital synthesis of frequency.

articleTitle: A nonsymmetrical two-dimensional p-n junction under the equilibrium
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The numerical simulations of the potential, the electric field intensity and the distribution of two-dimensional degenerate electron and hole gases are performed. It is shown that “squars rule” are not carry out.

articleTitle: Intelligent control system equipment “ARM-IR controller”
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In many socially important institutions (universities, clinics, kindergartens, etc.) has seen a rapid growth in the number of devices with an infrared receiver, equipped with a remote control (RC). The problem with this equipment is that its full functionality, as a rule, can only be obtained through the remote control, so if you do not have access to the remote device can not be used in normal mode. If the device is located in a remote place (near the ceiling), the impossible becomes even basic operations, such as switching on and off, control (for example, the temperature in the air conditioner).

articleTitle: To a question of modeling of dynamics of electro-magnetic drives
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Results of research of questions of development of software for research of dynamics of electromagnetic drives are submitted.

articleTitle: Information technologies at research of change of biopotential of plants from temperature action
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this article technical means for carrying out researches of dependence of biopotentials of plants from action on them various stressor on the example of temperature and the results received in the course of researches are described. Ways of completion of experimental installation and the direction of development of the plan of researches are discussed.

articleTitle: Nuclear synthesis can be carried out differently
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: As at bombardment of a target by the accelerated nuclear poisons the probability of nuclear reactions is small, it is necessary to apply other way of realization of nuclear reactions, modernizing the mentioned bombardment. In particular two-nuclear ions can be applied to synthesis of nucleus and manufacture of a nuclear energy. A two-nuclear ion accelerate in an electric field. Then both nucleus preliminary excited or preliminary broken on an ion and atom of a two-nuclear ion face among themselves inside or behind borders of a special target.

articleTitle: Stabilization of rotational speed of the DC motor with PWM in control channel based on time-scale-separation method
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The problem of regulation for a DC motor with autonomous voltage inverter is discussed. The considered control system consists of two feedback loops. In the first one, the armature current control for a DC motor is provided by means of pulse-width modulated control of autonomous voltage inverter. In the second one, DC motor speed control is maintained. Proportional-integral (PI) controllers are designed for armature current and motor speed control based on singular perturbation technique such that multi-time-scale motions are artificially induced in the closed-loop system.

articleTitle: Tracking in parametrically undefined linear systems
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: An approach to tracking controller design for single-input-single-output linear systems in the presents of unstable zero-dynamics and parametrically undefined mathematical model of the plant is proposed in the paper. It is assumed also that there is incomplete knowledge about ecosystem characteristics and state vector of the system. The presented approach is based on the theory of sliding motion control, state vector observer design and online identification of unknown parameters.

articleTitle: Development of information system of innovation evaluation at the meso level
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper is considered on the problem of the evaluation of innovation at the meso level. Business processes, which is involved in the evaluation, is identified and described by CASE-tools. The results of evaluation of innovation of 82 Regions using the developed information system are listed.

articleTitle: Aircraft Doppler spectrum features
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this article the features of Doppler spectra of aircraft on the example of turbojet aircraft are discussed; the application of parametric estimation methods of echo signals from radar target is evaluated.

articleTitle: Microplasma breakdown delay spectroscopy of deep level traps in the GaP:N light-emitting diodes
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: It was studied microplasma breakdown statistical delay in the green GaP:N light emitting diodes. It was detected unusual strong dependence of deep level traps on the avalanche breakdown statistical delay after changing their charge state with the voltage decreasing on the p-n junction in the temperature range 300–380 K. It was found out four deep level traps and determined their parameters.

articleTitle: Cepstrum analisys in vibrodiagnostics of gas turbine engines
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper focuses on the use of cepstral analysis in vibrodiagnostics. Also there is shown an overview of the main properties of the cepstrum and results of using cepstral analysis on data, obtained as a result of the gas turbine engine.

articleTitle: Autonomous anti-theft search satellite system
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The use of wireless technology and modern element base allowed to create a security system of high reliability.

articleTitle: The modeling of the influence non-identical frequency responses of the receiving channels on jamming cancellations
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Is offered the model designed to modeling the operation of the digital jamming cancellations with non-identical frequency responses of the receiving channels. Results of digital modeling are presented. The algorithms are designed to align the non-identical frequency responses of the receiving channels for jamming cancellations, are discussed.

Author Keywords: the non-identical frequency responses of the receiving channels

articleTitle: Implementation of functional transformation deposits in conductometric devices con-trol of electrolytes
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article and proposed methods for the implementation of functional changes of the measured values of the specific electric permittivity and temperature of the solution in the concentration of the electrolyte, considered the criteria for estimation and the comparative analysis of quality change.

articleTitle: Benefits of multifunctional reconfigurable intelligent sensors
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Multifunctional reconfigurable intelligent sensors are considered in this work (MRIS). The definition of MRIS is given. The differences between usual sensors and MRIS are considered. Also advantages of use of MRIS at design of modern information and measuring systems are presented in the article.

articleTitle: About one approach to synthesis of model system “suspended load”
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article is devoted to solution of stabilization problem of the load, which suspended on a crane rope. The non-linear differential equations, which describing of behavior of “suspended load“ system are given and the problem of stabilization is formulated. For the purpose of conditions check of a solubility of a synthesis problem research of mathematical model of system is conducted. The algorithm of stabilization taking into account features of mathematical model of system is developed. Results of simulation of close loop system with the regulator in the Matlab-Simulink environment are given.

articleTitle: System of visual measurement of level of fusion for the bathing recuperative furnace
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Article describes system of visual measurement of level of fusion for the bathing recuperative furnace. The block diagram and the interface of the user of the software of system of visual measurement of level of fusion are provided.

articleTitle: About experience of physical modeling of electromagnetic drive with digital control
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Results of research specially created of a breadboard model and model of an electromagnetic drive with digital control executed with use hardware and software LabVIEW are submitted.

articleTitle: Automatic gauge control system with combined control of the screw-down arrangement position
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: To reduce longitudinal gauge deviations of the head sections at the hot strip mill rolling it is reasonable to profile band of variable thickness due to the length provided by the linear motion of the screw-down arrangements under load. The paper considers the structure of the automatic gauge control system (ACGS) of the indirect type. It estimates the accuracy of screw-down arrangement position control in the single-loop automatic position control system. It also justifies the use of automatic position combined control system. The introduction of the additional channel of control due to the first derivative of the reference input signal was proved to provide the required accuracy values of the strip gauge control. The paper presents data of the pilot study of the developed system at OJSC Magnitogorsk Iron and Steel Works' mill 2,000; they confirm its efficiency.

articleTitle: Calculation of regulators for the problems of mechatronics by means of the numerical optimization method
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Methods for numerical optimization of regulators has a number of advantages as compared with the analytical methods. The use of modern software, together with well-known and newest methods of forming of the optimization criteria in the form of cost functions provides a set of methods, successfully tested on a number of tasks. These methods, in contrast to analytical ones, allow effectively calculation of robust regulators for objects even in the case of the simultaneous presence in these of non-linear elements, units of lag, discrete elements (such as sampling-and-hold analog storage) and other complicating singularities.

articleTitle: Information and measuring system for electric arc furnace transformer monitoring
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article focuses on importance of continuous control systems introduction for technical state control of electrical arc furnace transformers. Technical characteristics of FTOHBR-150200/35 transformers installed at 180 ton electric arc furnaces (EAF-180) of the electric steelmaking shop, OJSC “Magnitogorsk Iron and Steel Works”, are given. The authors considered the technological functions fulfilled by the system of technical state control. They described the operational diagram and the diagnostic TDMS system introduced at the EAF-180 No 1 and No 2 of the electric steelmaking shop. The advantages of the module structure are explained. The authors offer an example of time charts of recorded parameters and the screen view of generalized diagnostic characteristics. They also stated the technical and economic advantages offered by the developed system.

articleTitle: Information and measurement system for control of technical state of asynchronous electric motors with group supply from frequency converter
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper substantiates the significance of continuous control of the asynchronous motor technical state and diagnostic troubleshooting with group supply from the frequency converters. It also provides rationale for combined application of the stationary and mobile monitoring systems with the example of asynchronous motors in the roller table units of the Magnitogorsk Iron and Steel Works plate mill 5,000; as well as identifies their technical features. The paper substantiates requirements for functional configuration of the stationary system, considers its hardware providing compatibility with the Lab VIEW NATIONAL INSTRUMENTS software. The developed software is specified, too. The cross-correlation function and signal-to-noise ratio of the phase current are rationally considered as the major testing parameters. The paper also justifies performance of spectrum and current analysis of input currents. It provides the window of the application for visualization and storage of the electric drive operating condition data. The technical state of electric motors of roller tables tested is assumed and their proper functioning is established.

Author Keywords: group supply from the frequency converter

articleTitle: Active identification of linear stationary dynamic objects on base of the Fisher information matrix: the steady state
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The construction technique of the Fischer information matrix for the discrete stationary case when unknown parameters are in the state matrix, control matrix, process noise matrix is offered. Given work is offered to consider the steady state that considerably simplifies the technique which is essential and actual for practical use.

articleTitle: Integration prospects of electric drives based on back to back converters in industrial smart grid
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this article theoretical and mathematical studies were performed to define integration prospects of electric drives based on back to back converters in an industrial smart grid. Back to back converters can be actively used in operation of supply power system of enterprise as they are able to provide controlled power factor and bidirectional power flow. A back to back converter contains PWM boost rectifier which can carry out a compensation of reactive power in the grid using the increase of the direct current voltage level on the value of the voltage drop on the input inductor. The principle of maximum using consumption current of back to back converter to improve the efficiency was proposed. This principle most appropriately applied for parallel working with a nonlinear load.

articleTitle: The main connection circuits of the radiation-hardened differential difference amplifier based on the bipolar and field effect technological process
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The architecture and circuitry of the differential difference amplifier (DDA) with higher radiation hardness (the total dose of radiation is up to 1 millirad, the neutron flux is up to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13</sup> n/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) are reviewed. The fundamental equations are obtained which simplify the parameter determination of the analog and digital interfaces on its basis. The characteristics of the main connection circuits of DDA are examined taking into consideration the effect of the loop gain, transadmittance of the input stages and feedback resistors. It is shown that one circuit of DDA renders possible to provide rather wide set of the identical characteristics without feedback resistors at the inverting and noninverting connections.

articleTitle: Experimental examination of the strain characteristics of optical fibers
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The results of experimental examination of the strain characteristics (mechanical stresses) of optical fibers based on Brillouin backscattering spectrum analysis are given in this paper.

articleTitle: A comparative study of speed control based on MPC and PI-controller for Indirect Field oriented control of induction motor drive
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, a comparative study of speed control based on Model Predictive Control (MPC) and PI for Indirect Field oriented control of induction motor drive has been established. This paper proposes two schemes for vector control of induction motor (IM) drive. The first drive system is based on PI controller for speed control of IM. The second drive system is aimed to apply the MPC for speed control of IM. The performances of the two drive systems are compared. The validity of the two proposed systems have been demonstrated through computer simulations. The results obtained have confirmed that the drive system based on MPC is effective and robust against load disturbance. In addition, it has fast and good transient response over a wide speed range‥

articleTitle: Experimental researches of the temperature influence on Brillouin backscattering spectrum and strain characteristics of optical fibers
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The results of experimental researches of the temperature influence on the strain characteristics (mechanical stresses) of optical fibers based on Brillouin backscattering spectrum analysis are given in this paper.

articleTitle: Experimental researches of the transverse pressures influences on optical fibers, Brillouin backscattering spectrum and strain characteristics
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The results of experimental researches of the optical fibers characteristics with transverse pressures influences based on Brillouin backscattering spectrum analysis are given in this paper.

articleTitle: Three-phase AC voltage regulator as part of an autonomous system
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper construction of a system with the stabilization of the current value of the variable voltage and frequency based on AC-AC regulator with voltage boost with unity power factor function with PWM control is proposed. A mathematical model of the system is constructed. Results of investigation of the properties offered AC-AC regulators and their possible applications for stabilization of voltage in power supply autonomous systems, characterized by dual-range of change of the generated voltage are presented. The approach is based on the introduction of a high frequency variable voltage-additive supply voltage.

articleTitle: Representation of the voltage space vector of the multilevel inverter in oblique-angled coordinate systems of two delta voltages
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper deals with two key oblique-angled coordinate systems for the space vector representation of the multilevel voltage source inverter which are considered as the coordinate systems of two delta voltages. Simplicity of the algorithm of the choice of the three nearest vectors to the reference and the determining of their actions durations under space vector PWM (SVPWM) realization in oblique-angled coordinates system is shown. The roles of the integer values and the fractional values of the relative delta voltages are revealed. The conclusion is drawn that the oblique-angled 60- and 120-degree coordinates are equivalent and similar from the point of view of steps, operations and results of the SVPWM algorithm application. The insertion of calculations in oblique-angled coordinates operations (with use of the presented formulas of corresponding transformations) as the subblock into the basic algorithm of calculations on orthogonal components has been proposed.

articleTitle: New transformerless AC voltage regulators as devices to improve of power quality
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Several approaches to constructing of devices to improve of power quality are offered. In the first and second approaches multizone thyristor AC voltage regulators are offered, new transformerless transistor AC voltage regulators with switches per phase considers in the third, in the fourth approach a new family of buck-boost AC-AC regulators with a common switch are represented, based on the switching of quasi-impedance of power supply with a high frequency. The results of research of proposed regulators are shown.

articleTitle: Method for calculating the three-dimensional time-harmonic electromagnetic fields in marine electrical prospecting
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A new method for calculating the three-dimensional time-harmonic electromagnetic fields, allowing quick and accurate solution of the relevant problems, is presented. The method is based on the use of finite element approximations, the technology of field separation of a horizontally layered medium, and special mathematical statements for calculating the normal field. The proposed mathematical apparatus is described, and the results of computational experiments are presented.

articleTitle: Channel parameters and capacity measurement of MIMO LTE wireless channel
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper addresses wireless MIMO channel measurement in LTE system using wireless network analyzer TSMW Rohde&Schwarz and channel capacity estimation based on this measurement in urban environment. Channel capacity gain in dependence of signal to noise ratio and measured channel condition number are presented. Measured channel capacity CDF curves are presented.

articleTitle: Microwave equipment for MWD front-end radiolink in the borehole pipes
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper the X-band Gunn diode hybrid-integrated power amplifier-transmitter is proposed for the measurement-while-drilling (MWD) or logging-while-drilling (LWD) telemetry systems. This systems is a modern equipment for geophysics due transition from vertical to horizontal drilling. A review is presented of work on MWD, explaining the current high degree of interest in these subjects. The amplifier-transmitter operates in a new communication channel between drilling point to surface. This channel is characterized by high attenuation of signal. So main attention is paid to efficiently and low bias current. The transmitter design, simulated performances, and realized current-efficiently results are presented. The pulse output power is about 15–25 Watt in short-pulse mode, at 9 GHz central lobe. Measurement results are provided. Relation between measured output power and frequency of the center lobe as function of voltage and current of transmitter is determined. The aim of experiments is to test the effectiveness of the known voltage and current in order to increase output power. This work is carried out within a Microwave borehole project #13-02-98002 funded by the Russian Foundation for Basic Researches.

articleTitle: Finite element modeling of three-dimensional geoelectromagnetic fields excited by arbitrarily oriented induction source
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A method for the three-dimensional finite element modeling of geoelectromagnetic fields excited by an arbitrarily oriented induction source is proposed. The results of three-dimensional geoelectromagnetic fields calculations in the induction electrical logging are presented. The capabilities of the induction logging technology in the pulsed mode are analyzed on the basis of the results of 3D-modeling for solving the geonavigation tasks.

articleTitle: 3D surface mounting
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper presents the results from the research and development of the construction and technology of a 3 dimensional surface mounting. The main idea is to use surface mounting processes for assembly of high density modules. In order to do that, surface mounting on two or more levels is carried out. The difference from the stacked-die and other similar processes is that soldering takes place simultaneously on all levels. There is a predefined displacement aiming to check the stability of the process, and thus the degree of alignment is verified. It is shown that even when small technological error is introduced, process is realizable.

articleTitle: The methods of definition of the quantitative evaluation of internal safety of communication systems on the basis of the railway transport
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper contains methods of the quantitative evaluation of internal safety of communication systems on the railway transport with a glance to the influence different factors: internal and external. The calculation of safety parameters was made by methods of Markov chains, probabilistic mathematical modeling. The required level of the safety could be provided by defining of the rational service periodicity of communication systems on the railway transport.

articleTitle: A review of the properties of tests for uniformity
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A wide selection of tests for uniformity is considered. Distributions of test statistics under true null hypothesis are studied and power of tests is estimated by means of methods of statistical simulation. A comparative analysis of the power of tests is conducted. The conclusions are made on preference of one test or another under presence of specific competing alternatives.

articleTitle: Comparison between tracking and stabilizing PI controllers designed via time-scale separation technique
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper is devoted to comparison of the properties of tracking and stabilizing PI controllers which are designed via time-scale separation technique. It has been shown that the proposed tracking PI controller allows to provide robust output control and almost perfect tracking under model uncertainties and external disturbances as well as the stabilizing PI controller allows providing desired output transients performances under step change of set point. Robust control is provided due to two-time-scale motions that are artificially forced in the closed-loop system.

articleTitle: Algorithm of scene change detection in a video sequence based on the threedimensional histogram of color images
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: There has been an analysis of the influence of the choice of the color space, a measure of comparison of histograms and their size on the performance of the detection algorithm moments scene change. It is shown that the choice of HSV space and histogram intersection method can reduce the error rate in detection of moments, when scene changes and the effective size of the histogram. The experimental results of the algorithm are shown.

articleTitle: Research on possibility of visualization of biologically active points by light illumination
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Results of preliminary experiments on the possibility of biologically active points (BAP) visualization by illuminating them with light pulse causing luminescence of the skin surface in the BAP area are considered. The locations of the BAPs were checked by electrical resistance measurements and by the location topography.

articleTitle: Development of a parallel program to perform a permutation test with the use of GPU
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper proposes an algorithmic approach and program for solving search problems statistically significant over the biological characteristics of genes in a given set. The problem is connected with the implementation of well known in biology permutation (randomization) test. By taking into account the potential parallelism permutation test developed in parallel with the implementation of a program to graphically processors. Provides estimates of the effectiveness of the application of the developed program on empirical material.

articleTitle: Active parametric identification of stochastic linear discrete system based on optimal design of input signals and initial states
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Under consideration are some theoretical and applied aspects of the active parametric identification of the multidimensional stochastic linear discrete systems described by state space models. Original results are obtained in the case that the parameters of mathematical models to be estimated appear in various combinations in the state and measurement equations, as well as the covariance matrices of the process noise and measurement errors. By an example of one model structure, the efficiency and sensibility is shown of applying the active identification procedure based on optimal design of input signals and initial states.

articleTitle: Our way to power electronic transformers
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In article evolution of the researches executed to Scientific laboratory `Energy optimization of power convertors' (EOPS) which can serve an innovative direction in the power electronics, connected with working out of power electronic transformers of an alternating current for needs electrical engineers and power is tracked. Three directions in construction of such transformers are considered: on converters with a direct connection, on converters with an intermediate link of the higher frequency and on converters with a DC intermediate link. The basic properties of converters of each direction are noted.

articleTitle: Investigation of the printed dual-band quasi-Yagi monopole antenna matching
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article describes a printed dual-band quasi-Yagi monopole antenna. The key object of the article is investigation of antenna matching. To analyze the antenna matching, results of electromagnetic modeling are presented. These results are graphs of antenna's reflection coefficient. Comparison of the monopole dual-band antenna with dipole dual-band antennas is presented.

articleTitle: Applying of combined algorithm for prediction urban road traffic based on fuzzy search theory
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article analyzes the problem of road traffic progress prediction in the city. Proposed mathematical models and algorithms allow to solve the problem of traffic jam prediction using statistics about the traffic parameters incoming from vehicle monitoring systems. The algorithm of road traffic situation prediction based on known approaches fuzzy search in relational databases using a mixed criterion. The prediction algorithm had been successfully tested using satellite vehicle monitoring data pick up for more than a year. Application of described methods makes possible to achieve high results in predicting of traffic jam. The results of using the proposed prediction method was compared with widely used average speed extrapolation method and actual data for the study period of time.

articleTitle: Construction of the membership function for fuzzy forecasting models
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Prediction of energy consumption based on the theory of fuzzy sets are widely used nowadays. In this paper, the algorithm of constructing the functions of belonging to several fuzzy sets based on the method of expert estimations.

articleTitle: Experimental examination of the Brillouin backscattering spectrum in dispersion-shifted optical fibers
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The results of experimental examination of the strain characteristics (mechanical stresses) of dispersion-shifted single mode optical fibers (DSF) based on Brillouin backscattering spectrum analysis are given in this paper.

articleTitle: Cascade model predictive vector control of induction motor drive
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, an approach using three model predictive controllers has been investigated for vector control induction motor drive. These controllers are connected in cascade in the feedforward, the first is used for speed control, the second is used for rotor flux control and the third is dedicated for current control. The validity of the proposed system has been demonstrated through computer simulations. A comparison between the proposed system and PI control has been offered. The results obtained have confirmed that the proposed system is effective and robust against load disturbance. In addition, it has fast and good dynamic response over a wide speed range.

articleTitle: The influence of n-type silicon piezoresistors pre-strain state on their piezoresistance
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Theory of n-type silicon longitudinal and transverse piezoresistance coefficients in the case of uniaxial pre-strain state along [100] crystallographic axis is presented. Numerical calculations for various impurity concentrations in a range of 1·10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">16</sup> - 1·10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> are performed. It has been shown that compressive pre-strain state of the piezoresistor can increase the longitudinal piezoresistance coefficient on 60 %.

articleTitle: Parallelization research of algorithm for detecting borders on the basis of graph representation
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper we consider software implementation algorithm for finding the boundaries of objects in images using Sobel operator. Software implementation is presented in structural-graphical form. We propose a semi-automatic parallelization considered program load. Parallelized algorithm implemented in software product and the efficiency of parallelization was analyzed.

articleTitle: Insular power supply battery manager with balancing and protection unit for Lithium-Ion batteries
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: For insular supply of electricity off-grid, Lithium-Ion Batteries are an optimal choice when disregarding the price due to their high power and high energy capability and low self-discharge rate. However, they require careful balancing and some advanced protection system components that go far beyond standard electronics for lead-acid batteries. Power coming from photovoltaic panels easily can overcharge the battery in summer months. A special high current charge controller was established for input energy turn off once the battery is full. Some safety levels are introduced to reduce risks. In addition to standard full-battery turn off of photovoltaic input a thyristor-short-circuiter is inserted, too. If for any reason voltage at battery exceeds a certain peak voltage the short-circuit-thyristor is fired and this action disconnects the battery from the input by blowing a high current high speed emergency fuse. Lithium Ion batteries easily survive short circuits of limited duration e.g. lasting less than several seconds. A system operation display is integrated. Photovoltaic charging, full battery, balancing of individual cells, over-voltage and under-voltage of the battery are indicated by LEDs. Charge current and battery voltage is displayed by digital voltmeters. A prototype connected to a 12 V / 1600 Ah battery unit is in test application presently.

articleTitle: On natural linewidth of Fabry-Perot lasers; simulation of experiments
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A medium component of the natural linewidth is considered, the component being found when applying nonlinear photorefractivity on laser frequencies. The natural linewidth is calculated on the basis of a new formula for the line shape which has been derived in the process of applying nonlinear photorefractivity. Medium, phase, and amplitude components of the natural linewidth are taken into account. We have defined and found the numerical values of laser parameters describing the natural linewidth of Fabry-Perot semiconductor lasers by solving an inverse problem, and then have simulated all experimental measurements represented in the literature we have available.

articleTitle: Multifrequency microwave measurements in the intermediate zone of radiation with inverse aperture synthesis for radio image forming
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Experimental results of reflectivity measurements for metal sphere with diameter of 35.5 mm and cylinder with the base diameter of 38 mm and the height of 76 mm in the range of 38-52 GHz at the grid of 256 frequencies are presented. Application of reference discontinuity in the form of iris positioned in the throat of the horn allowed implementing Fourier-holography principle and obtaining complex time-domain signal of reflection from the object by Fourier transform of data in frequency domain. The magnitude of reflection directly from the sphere is proportional to its diameter. The method of inverse aperture synthesis on the basis of the method generalized spatial inverse filtration is proposed. The peculiarity of inverse aperture synthesis implementation is application this approach to the time-domain signal. For the experimental data the spatial resolution was improved in 2 times by inverse aperture synthesis. The suggested data processing method provided possibility to form radio image of the objects.

articleTitle: Elliptic filters with quarter-wave coupling
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper presents the circuit solutions and design procedure for UHF elliptic filters with quarter-wave coupling. Design procedure is based on equal two-stage crossing from parallel lumped circuit to multimodal oscillating system, with closely spaced resonant frequencies.

articleTitle: Installation for study of oscillatory processes in electrical circuits
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The generator of relaxation oscillations on the unijunction transistor is investigated. On its basis the generator of rectangular impulses is designed and manufactured, which is used in this work for fast charging of the capacitor when studying free oscillations in RLC- circuit. Measurements of all parameters of a contour are carried out. By means of an additional high-frequency detector and of devices of the generator AHP-1003 and the oscilloscope TDS2012B quality amplitude-frequency characteristics are measured. Technical results of the conducted researches are the new laboratory installation for study of oscillatory processes in electrical circuits and the generator of rectangular impulses on the unijunction transistor.

Author Keywords: Measuring instrument of the amplitude-frequency characteristic

articleTitle: Increasing the reliability of authentication keyboard handwriting
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article presents authentication method that differs from other methods by possibility to determine probability of both kinds of errors a priori. At the first stage is comparison of keystrokes intervals with standard by the Spearman correlation coefficient. At the next stage is shift check by Wilcoxon signed-rank test and check of scale parameter difference by Sandvik-Ollson criterion. The very first case of difference leads to access denial. The article also provides results of experimental verification of authenticator, peculiarities of keystroke dynamics and recommendations for the standard sampling.

articleTitle: Energy-efficient synchronous machine control
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper a solution to the problem of synchronous machine control optimal synthesis on the basis of maximum principle and energy state function is presented.

articleTitle: The principle of motions separation in state observers under the action of disturbances
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper deals with state observer design problem for a nonlinear system under the action of disturbances. Decomposition synthesis of the observer with corrective actions in the form of sat-functions is designed. This observer provides estimates for unmeasured variables of the state vector and external disturbances without entering their dynamic model. These algorithms are used in the control problem of induction motor with incomplete measurements and the action of external disturbance.

articleTitle: Broadband microwave attenuators of the high level power
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In operation results of research and development of the broadband microwave attenuator providing in case of use of forced air cooling power carrying input power to 1 kW are provided. It's shown that its implementation on the basis of the microstrip technology provides a uniform amplitude-frequency characteristic and low value of VSWR in broad band of frequencies.

articleTitle: The experimental research of security of speech information of leakage from technical channels with account of forcing speech effect
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Experimental research (articulation tests) of influence of forcing speech effect on security of speech information of leakage from technical channels was executed. Results of experiment and theoretical calculations are compared. Conclusions and justifications of the received results are made.

articleTitle: Voltage stabilization in multilevel inverters
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The combined system to stabilize the output voltage of the converter based on multilevel voltage inverter, in which each of two independently operating subsystems implements well-known methods of waste stabilization, is considered. It is proved that the system provides high performance stabilization process with minimal reduction in the average quality of the output voltage of the curve.

articleTitle: A method of increasing the stability of the zero level analog circuits based on the “Folded” cascode with the high-impedance point branch in the terms of temperature and radiation effects
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: It is considered the problem of synthesis of structural and schematics of bipolar analog ICs based on the classic “folded” cascode which have a small zero-level (offset voltage, V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ov</sub>) and its drift in the terms of temperature and radiation effects. Thus the basis of the modernization of the scheme are adopted by well-known basic analog IC (operational amplifiers, continuous stabilizers, voltage comparators, etc.), in which by the rules set forth below, we introduce some structural redundancy, which provides a decrease V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ov</sub> and its voltage drift effect on one or two orders).

articleTitle: Input impedances of dipole and dipole-like antennas with prescribed phase difference between excitation currents
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A novel variations of the conventional dipole radiator are analyzed. By properly choosing theirs parameters and outgoing lines of the exciting power divider/balun, it is possible to create the versions of the antenna that have suitable range of input impedance and figure-eight tilted radiation patterns. The change of the lengths of the outgoing lines allows the currents on the two arms of the antenna to have prescribed phase difference, thereby making the antenna operate at various states with corresponding E-plane maximum beam direction. The corresponding expressions for complex input impedances are derived in this paper.

articleTitle: Radiation resistance of center-end-fed dipole radiator with prescribed phase difference between excitation voltages
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A novel variation of the conventional dipole radiator is proposed and named as the center-end-fed dipole radiator (CEFDR). By properly choosing theirs parameters, it is possible to create the versions of the antenna that have suitable range of input resistance and figure-eight tilted radiation patterns. The proposed antenna with relatively low profile and high polarization purity is very suitable candidate for mobile communication systems with single linear, dual linear or circular polarization.

articleTitle: The high-voltage stand-up DC-DC converter for electric locomotives
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the given report is presented the new scheme of DC 24kV-3kV converter for electric locomotives. The principle of work of the scheme is described. The load characteristic, the efficiency and factor of harmonics of an input current and output voltage is defined.

articleTitle: Problems of transfer of a figure of topology when forming 3D structures (the FinFET-technology of transistors)
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Experimentally it is confirmed that PHE Si process in CCl2F2/O2 plasma is well compatible to a photoresistive mask on the basis of FP-383. Dependences of rate of PHE Si on value of flows of oxygen and freon, anode current, sample layout in the reactor, physical characteristics of a silicon sample, etching time are studied. The PHE Si optimum mode suitable for practical use is found.

articleTitle: Research of model specifications tests under failure of normality assumption
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Ramsey RESET-test and J-test are designed with the assumption of Gaussian distribution of the random component of the model. It is demonstrated that Ramsey RESET-test is robust to disturbance in the assumption of Gaussian distribution model errors except the distribution with heavy tail. The effects on J-test statistics distribution of model specifications residuals distribution are considered.

articleTitle: Graphics processing unit implementation of Hidden Markov models
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article presents a method of Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) implementation of Hidden Markov Models (HMM) for the task of multidimensional sequences classification. The execution times of method on Central Processing Unit (CPU) and GPU were compared.

articleTitle: State primary standard of electrical quality factor unit SPS 139-2013
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Here are described composition, the operating principle, metrological characteristics of the state primary standard of quality factor, developed at the Siberian Red Labor Banner Research Institute of Metrology.

articleTitle: Input impedance of ends-fed dipole radiator with prescribed phase difference between excitation currents
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A novel excitation of the conventional ends-fed dipole radiator is analyzed. By properly choosing its parameters and outgoing lines of the exciting power divider/balun, it is possible to create the versions of the antenna that have suitable range of input impedance and figure-eight tilted radiation patterns. The change of the lengths of the outgoing lines allows the currents on the two arms of the antenna to have prescribed phase difference, thereby making the antenna operate at various states with corresponding E-plane maximum beam direction. The corresponding closed-form expression for complex input impedance is derived in this paper.

articleTitle: Multilevel algebraic methods of modeling the 3D electromagnetic field
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper we consider the special multilevel algorithm for solving systems of linear algebraic equations obtained by the finite element discretization of the vector Helmholtz equation in the 3D domains with internal borders. The algorithm is based on the multilevel Schwarz method and the domain decomposition with an overlap. The results of calculations allow us to estimate the contribution of the each stage of the algorithm to the acceleration of the calculation procedures.

articleTitle: Fabrication of microcuvettes using anodic aluminum oxide membrane
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A variant for preparing an anodic aluminium oxide (AAO) membrane in copper ring with deposited tin last layer is proposed in the work. It allows to create closed microholders (microcuvettes) with developed nanostructured surface by soldering. Classical techniques as photolithography, electrochemical oxidation and metal deposition, etching and soldering was used. Is it approved by FTIR-analysis, that the prepared by proposed technological scheme cuvettes can be used as closed volumes containing gas and volatile liquids with designation of optical sensors.

articleTitle: Information complex models of agriculture objects
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: On the basis of the law on cycle of matter in the nature the dialectic scheme of interrelation of objects of an agricultural production is offered: the earth, plants, animals, machinery and environment. The paradigm of a dataware of technological processes of an agricultural production is offered. Information models of machine-tractors aggregate and agrophytocenosis (parts and a plant as a whole, a phytosanitary condition - diseases, pests, weeds) are offered. Currently there was accurate clear-eyed enough understanding of subject and backbone branches of knowledge and their role in formation of a gross national product (GNP). Subject sciences define prospects of development of concrete branches and are the basic generators of their development and qualitative growth. Information technologies is in certain understanding system knowledge of the inter-branch character directed on creation of additional cost in branches, both on branch and on inter-branch levels. It shouldn`t identify information technology with technology (s) of informatics. The technology of informatics is only a part of information technologists [1] as the last is a branch of knowledge, and the first is a whole set of methods (including. computer programs) and means (devices, information-measuring systems, computers etc.). We divide approaches to agroinformatics and to agroinformation technologies by analogy. The branch character of agroinformatics in the general system of the informatics, connected with unity of objects of consideration in agrarian sphere, is underlined thereby. The earth, plants, animal, machinery, environment and society act as objects in the generalized view in agrarian sphere. The subject branch of knowledge of agrarian (agricultural) sciences study the processes proceeding in objects of agrarian sphere, and also processes of their interactions.

articleTitle: Experience of network neuro-rehabilitation project implementation in Russia
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper describes an experience of developing a computer system for continuous medical rehabilitation involving patients with post-stroke and spinal cord injury motor disorders. Particular focus is made on the concept of telerehabilitation for this specific group of patients. Telerehabilitation has to be continuous and regular. It is also necessary to provide the possibility of conducting treatment/communication sessions asynchronously. The empirical results of five year implementation of this system in Russia showed high efficiency and revealed some limitations of a distant network rehabilitation program based on electromyographic biofeedback.

articleTitle: Assessment of mean time between failures of metrological support and control of production
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Any parametres have a relevant Annotation - mean time between failures diminishes in the process of system activity before some minimum value, corresponding to a set stationary process of restoration. This fact causes necessity to study in detail issues relating to stability of systems to support efficient functioning of metrological systems.

articleTitle: Modernization of the test at the course of the “Fundamentals of Power Electronics”
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Electronic test 2004 version requires updating and implementing some of the features: a random questions, graphic elements and multi-platform. Using web-technologies, develop a skin of test program “Fundamentals of Power Electronics”.

articleTitle: Comb-drive variable capacitor design features for vibration energy generator
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Comb-drive variable capacitor construction parameters influence on maximal-to-minimal capacitance is studied. Comb-drive variable capacitor construction with electrode overlap area change at different comb width and electrode thickness is modeled. The increase of maximal-to-minimal capacitance ratio has been observed when comb width was decreased and electrode thickness was increased without substantial modification of the variable capacitor dimension. The results obtained allows to enhance the efficiency of vibration energy generator by increasing their output power.

articleTitle: Calculation and modeling long-haul DWDM system with advanced format modulation tolerated by chromatic dispersion
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper investigate influence of nonlinear effects with no compensation link. The Non-linear optical phenomena greatly enhanced our knowledge about interaction of light with matter and created a dramatic change in optics technology. This nonlinear products will reduce the optical signal to noise ratio (OSNR) which in turn increases the Bit Error Rate (BER). Also, authors propose some solution for calculation OSNR for usage different methods.

articleTitle: Experimental channel parameters and capacity measurement of wireless MIMO channel at 2.4 GHz
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper addresses wireless MIMO channel sounding method and channel capacity estimation based on this measurement in urban environment. Channel capacity gain in dependence of signal to noise ratio for various antenna configuration is presented. Measured channel capacity CDF curves are presented.

articleTitle: Precise measurement of the objects self-capacitance of inductive nature
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper presents the methodology for measuring of the self-capacitance in the frequency range from 0.05 to 300 MHz. There are measurement results with using these methods for standards-copies of electrical quality factor unit of the State primary standard of electrical quality factor GET 139-2013.

articleTitle: The resolution power of hydraulic fracturing monitoring seismic antenna
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: It is investigated resolution power of the seismic antenna used in an original method of ground-based monitoring of hydraulic fracturing. The limiting measurement error estimation of nodes coordinates of the virtual three-dimensional grid imposed on productive layer space is given. 4 variants of the structured location grids are offered. Grids comparison results by criterion of maximum seismic antenna resolution power are brought.

articleTitle: Description of industrial control system of pump station with using of UML diagrams
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Description of the industrial control system (ICS) of pump station is given in the paper. Structure and properties of the system are described with help of classes and objects UML diagrams. Classes and objects contain properties that discretely present system characteristics: pressure in pipe, power of pump motor and elements state. For the whole system representation and possibility of automatically program code generation we propose implement UML diagrams that represent structure of ICS of pump station after that implement dynamic UML diagrams.

articleTitle: The modified method of demodulation N-OFDM signals
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this article the method of demodulating of non-orthogonal N-OFDM signals, that are formed by Hartley transform, is described. N-OFDM demodulation was based on the assessment of accepted amplitudes by Cauchy method, by solving a system of linear algebraic equations. In addition, the article consider the possibility of increasing the spectral efficiency of the system due to compression of N-OFDM, and system's interference immunity by introducing algorithm of demodulation threshold device.

articleTitle: Research of the lambda Wilks statistic distribution under conditions of violation of basic assumptions in the discriminant function analysis
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper studies how the lambda Wilks statistic distribution in the discriminant function analysis changes under conditions of data inhomogeneity. It also addressed the test power based on the lambda Wilks statistic.

articleTitle: Determination of internal combustion engine power in a dynamic way using the methodology of analysis of stochastic processes
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The theoretical and experimental investigations of transient process of crankshaft's speed during an engine's acceleration phase are presented. The analysis of dynamic characteristics of the engine by its velocity characteristic's correlation function are conducted. The zones where the transient process is quasi-stationary are determined, that allows to determine the engine's characteristics by statistical way.

articleTitle: ALU design problems research with VLSI CAD “Kovcheg 2.2”
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In paper possibility of ALU's realization on MPGA 5503 XM2 developed on microprocessor MOS Technology 6502 (USA) first demonstrated. Design cycle of ALU has been done, including modeling of truth table and topology formation. Shown, that 5503 library is functionally complete and support effective design of all components of 6502 microprocessor's ALU.

articleTitle: Data experiments management on Web-technologies basisi
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article describes the Web-based dataprocessing system conceptual elements, architecture and software. The system manages field and computational experiments structured and unstructured data. The system provides users with search, computational, analytical and GIS services to effectively work with data. As an example of the proposed architecture practical implementation this article presents the «Vibroseismic Earth Sounding» data-processing system developed by the authors. The system manages data obtained during active vibroseismic monitoring experiments.

articleTitle: Prospects for creating of standard complex for metrological maintenance of biophysical measurements
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article discusses the prospects of creating of Standard complex for metrological maintenance of biophysical parameters of blood cells (RBCs).

articleTitle: On natural linewidth of distributed feedback lasers; simulation of experiments
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The natural linewidth in DFB lasers is calculated on the basis of a new formula for the line shape which has been derived in the process of applying effective nonlinear photorefractivity which is assumed. Corrugation, phase, and amplitude components of the natural linewidth are taken into account. We have defined and found numerical values of laser parameters describing the natural linewidth of DFB lasers by solving an inverse problem, and then have simulated 12 experimental measurements.

articleTitle: Comparison of statistical and probabilistic model of the frequency measurement by method coincidence
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The research represents the comparison of statistical and probabilistic model of the frequency measurement by method coincidence.

articleTitle: Choice of scanning signal working frequency for skin surface sponginess estimation using ultrasonic vibrations
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The research on the choice of scanning signal working frequency for skin surface sponginess estimation using ultrasonic vibrations has been made. The experimental setup has been designed. It is shown that the maximum change of the piezoplate voltage is at the resonance frequency for both cases: contact with air and contact with skin surface. The optimum scanning signal frequency for the considered radiator is 485 kHz.

articleTitle: By estimating parameters of distribution lines and devices in the range of radio waves supply substations telecommunications facilities, taking into account switching noise and lightning
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A method for the analysis and algorithm metrological evaluation of interference of radio frequency waves in distribution network supplying telecommunications facilities. We consider a model of electrical circuits supply substation and an algorithm for computing the equivalent parameters of circuits during switching impacts and lighting strokes.

articleTitle: The program for calculation of the areas of any form figures with possibility of input and editing of arithmetic expressions
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this article the program for calculation of the areas of any form figures on images with possibility of input and editing of arithmetic expressions for the subsequent data processing about the received areas is described. The program is applied to definition of a mass fraction of the connected moisture in the field of research of meat and meat products, determination of the full area of leaves of plants, the surface area damaged by diseases, wreckers and other factors of environment, determination of the area of the struck crops on space pictures.

articleTitle: The technique of modal synthesis method with decoupling control channels
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The problem of finding an algorithm for matrix feedback, providing the specified zeros individual transfer functions, until finally solved in control theory of linear stationary systems. As for a multidimensional system matrix system provides a predetermined range of the poles is not unique, then, generally speaking, this is not the only can be used to organize the above mentioned zeros, followed by the possibility of compensation. Attempt to solve this problem and the subject of this article.
