Providing a full range of poles of the system
Compensation zeros of the transfer matrix method for calculating the matrix modification feedback

articleTitle: Options forming method of competent reserve for project staff
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The goal of the work is a problem solving of project staff formation during enterprise modernization. The mathematical model for options generation is developed, which consist of the least covering set problem. The valuation method for employees competent reserve is offered. The method allows to form the set of possible alternatives for determination the best solution by cost minimization.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of the vertical complementary NPN bipolar transistor
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper we consider the numerical simulation TCAD Sentaurus of the vertical NPN transistor fabricated on complementary bipolar technology with a P-epitaxial layer. As a result, technological parameters associated with the buried and epitaxial layers have been defined. These parameters have provided the required voltage value collector-emitter breakdown. Comparison of the transistor output characteristics with the experimental data has showed the adequate accuracy of simulation for practical.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of methods of adaptation in the correction of the frequency characteristics of systems by the IIR filter
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The adaptive equalization of frequency characteristic of systems by the IIR filter is analyzed. Comparative results of application for the least squares method and sequential regression method are presented.

articleTitle: The dosymetric parameters investigation of the pulsed gamma radiation source based on betatron
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the paper the dosimetric parameters measurement technique of the pulsed bremsstrahlung generated by betatron is described. The dose and the dose rate measurement results from the pulsed bremsstrahlung generated by betatron are presented. The dose rate spatial distributions of the pulsed bremsstrahlung generated by betatron obtained with the help of the thermoluminescent dosimeters DTL-02 and the cylindrical ionization chamber type 30013 are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Microstrip broadband band-pass filters
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Microstrip broadband band-pass filters based on the multimode resonator are investigated. The use in constructions of the strip conductor in the form of an irregular meander allows to create filters with high frequency selective properties. The good conformance of the calculated data in comparison with the received data on experimentally made microwave device is shown.

articleTitle: Criteria of the matrix of analog passive all-pass network
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Criteria which enable to define the structure of matrix of analog passive all-pass network for the synthesis of the matching device with prescribed phase response are determined in this paper.

articleTitle: Using spline-function for the reason unceasing description of the metrological features of the measures ORF
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In report are considered questions of the unceasing description of the metrological features of the measures ORF on source discrete ensemble result measurements.

articleTitle: Microwave characterization of nanomechanical resonator
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: We suggest a new method for microwave diagnostics of nanomechanical resonators. The system under consideration is a microwave coplanar line (MWCL), interacting through a capacitive load with nanomehanichal resonator (NAMR). The input is a superposition of two signals with close frequencies, one of which coincides with the fundamental frequency of the MWCL. Thus NAMR is excited by a difference frequency, which leads to a modulation of the output signal at this frequency. The modulation amplitudes of the output signal has the characteristic peaks at the resonant frequency of the NAMR, which allows the determination of the position of the NAMR resonance and its quality factor. The paper presents a theoretical calculation of the modulation amplitudes. It is shown that their frequency dependence has a characteristic Lorentzian structure with the position of the peak and the width being determined by NAMR resonance characteristics.

articleTitle: Method and algorithms of operation monitoring and quality management in process of multi-component mixtures preparation
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Tools of operation monitoring and tools of multi-component mixtures quality management in process of their preparation with a two-step dosing scheme are reviewed. Algorithms of bringing multi-component mixtures with certain composition into a specified composition are presented.

articleTitle: Analysis of performance issues in point-to-multipoint data transport for big data
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper describes the state of contemporary open-source reliable multicast solutions and reveals deficiencies regarding their use for massive data transport in Content Delivery Networks (CDN). A performance analysis of the three most popular open-source solutions - UDP-based File Transport Protocol, NACK-oriented Reliable Multicast and Pragmatic General Multicast in multi-gigabit IP-based networks has been performed in the 10Gigabit-WAN laboratory of the Future Internet Lab Anhalt of Anhalt University of Applied Sciences. This evaluation has been performed under the real-world scenario of heavyweight content distribution in Wide Area Networks. Performance evaluation presented in this paper reveals bottlenecks and deficiencies in current approaches. On this basis we propose new ideas for improvements and further development of the reliable multicast data delivery protocols family.

articleTitle: Modeling information space for decision-making in the interaction of higher education system with regional labor market
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper describes novel approach to constructing decision-making support system based on multi-dimensional model of information space for the process of interaction between higher education system and regional labor market. The particular features of the proposed approach are: accumulation of data with the use of web-scrapping intelligent information system, building multi-dimensional OLAP-warehouse with data consolidation and aggregation, analysis of data based on OLAP technology and deep Data Mining. We provide an overview of up-to-date online data auto-collection technologies, and describe the architecture of the intelligent system accumulating labor market data since 2011. Finally, an example of analysis is presented that allows hypothesizing that labor market is oversaturated by NSTU graduates of certain majors.

articleTitle: The analytical review of tests for randomness and the absence of av trend
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Annotation - For a variety of parametric acnd nonparametric tests, designed to test hypotheses of randomness or absence of a trend the distribution of statistics were investigated with Monte-Carlo algorithm, corresponding to the truth of the hypothesis under test in accordance with sample sizes. Procedure of interactive simulation of statistic distributions tests is proposed and implemented that allowed to apply the relevant test correctly in conditions of violation of standard assumptions. The results of comparative analysis of power of the tests against competing hypotheses hypothesis with different models of linear trend, conclusions about preferability of using a particular test are made.

articleTitle: Design of PI and PID controllers for multivariable systems based on time-scale separation technique
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Problem of PI and PID multivariable controller design based on time-scale separation technique for linear time-invariant systems is discussed. Properties of tracking and stabilizing multivariable controllers are treated. Generalized multivariable controllers are proposed for MIMO systems when the conditions of invertibility and internal stability hold. The internal stability analysis of the system is based on consideration of the normal canonical form. Simulation results and comparison of tracking and stabilizing multivariable controllers are presented.

articleTitle: Nonlinear process control — once-through boiler
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper presents the nonlinear control system design algorithm - the localization method - applied to the output superheater of the coal power plant once-through boiler. Theoretical basics of the localization method are shown. Linear and nonlinear models of the superheater were earlier developed. Basic descriptions of these models properties are presented, too. The control of the plant is processed by two control cascades; each of these cascades uses the localization controller and the special element for derivatives evaluating the differentiating filter. Through the research there were the different localization loop configuration developments. Simulation results for these variants of the localization loops are presented.

articleTitle: Estimation of control errors influence on availability of multipath routing system
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper concerns the availability analysis of multipath routing using Markov processes. Investigated system includes periodic non-ideal control module. This control module is used to obtain path failures. Non-ideal means that there could be errors of control, when operating state is recognized as non-operating and vice versa. Also path restoration could be non-ideal. It means that after path restoration packet loss still exist.

articleTitle: Robust generation of invariant detectors in uncertain noise environments
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: New adaptive asymptotically robust invariant algorithms are proposed, and examined. These algorithms are used for the detection of signals with some unknown parameters observed in additive noise with unknown distribution. The algorithms are based on asymptotically robust invariant (ARI) algorithms previously developed by the authors. The extended model of approximately finite probability distributions (q-point model) is employed for algorithm synthesis. Adaptation is achieved by estimating and optimizing the algorithm for the unknown parameters of the q-point model. The algorithms characteristics were obtained by computer simulation for the case of BPSK modulation.
