articleTitle: Development of STATCOM with stepless reactive power control using Z-bus matrix for determination of compensation level
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper presents the results of developing a static reactive power compensator (STATCOM) model with the use of a Z-bus matrix for determination of required load-based compensation level.

articleTitle: Comparison of the acentric properties for the oxide crystals
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The indistinct empiric linear correlation between values of nonlinear optical (NLO) and piezoelectric properties, spontaneous polarization and NLO-properties has been established for noncentrosymmetric (NCS) oxide crystals. But nonlinear empiric correlation with the maximum has been found between piezoelectric - electrooptic, and piezoelectric - non-linear optical properties of these ones. These data has been useful at search of the most optimal materials for optoelectronic devices.

articleTitle: A DC-link current study of the Capacitor Clamped Converter
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper presents a DC-link current study of Indirect Matrix Converter (IMC) and Capacitor Clamped Converter based on IMC and Flying Capacitor (FC) technologies. The general control techniques are introduced with computer simulation for all investigated schemes and obtained results are given and discussed in the article.

articleTitle: Image analysis algorithms for forest fire monitoring systems
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: We describe principles of development of some forest image analysis algorithms proposed for implementation in forest fire early detection systems. Algorithms of geometric background aligning, image segmentation, intensity smoothing, and high-intensity objects contrast detection and movement detection are considered. We demonstrate functionality of developed algorithms and suggest some recommendations on their application.

articleTitle: Object model for analysis of multiservice telecommunications networks
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Article is devoted to the design of universal object model for telecommunication networks. Decomposition of telecommunication domain has been described with emphasis on classes designing and development process for general structure of the model. Presented object model was implemented in the form of software and the influence of repeated calls on the performance of telecommunication network with dynamic routing has been analyzed.

articleTitle: Adaptive control of a variable wind speed turbine based on fuzzy logic
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Inthispaper an adapted control scheme based on fuzzy logic approachfor adjusting the turbine speed so as to track the maximum power point. This scheme can help to control wind turbine speed for maximum power extracting for a given wind velocity.

articleTitle: Method of adaptive computing as a basis for constructing the computational core for special matchers
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article is devoted to the modern solutions of the synthesis problem. The article is describes the algorithm parallelization computing by mask predetermined a mathematical formula and implementation of the data in computational core of specialized a microprocessor systems.

articleTitle: Features of pull-in effect in one-capacitor MEMS
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The analysis of the functioning of one-capacitor microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) with a plane-parallel and interdigitated electrode structure based on electromechanical interactions is conducted. The influence of the initial conditions is considered. The analysis was conducted by examining the phase trajectories. It is shown that the allowable values of power supply voltage, where the pull-in-effect has not manifested for two-electrode MEMS plane-parallel electrodes design, higher than the corresponding values for the design of MEMS comb electrodes. Found that at the initial stage of work the pull-in-effect in the MEMS data can be observed in the power supply voltage, significantly lower values of V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0,кp</inf>, which are determined only by the conditions of static equilibrium. The obtained analytical expressions allow to define the field of initial conditions (displacement and velocity), where the effects of the collapse of the electrodes does not occur. It is shown that the weight of the movable electrode can significantly influence the manifestation and the lack of the pull-in-effect.

articleTitle: Magnetotherapy biotechnical system for rapid wound healing
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper discusses the options for nodes pulsed magnetic influence running magnetic field for the rapid healing of surgical wounds and long-healing ulcers. A signal generator was designed to power inductor, and also been proposed inductor switching circuits of the matrix to create magnetic fields of different configurations.

articleTitle: Modelling of management process by laser radiation in devices for the laser physiotherapy
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this article problems of development of a technique of biomanagement and biosin-synchronization of laser radiation for a physiotherapy and development of the system of management of laser radiation for the medical devices used in a physiotherapy are surveyed.

articleTitle: Constructing a model of fracture zone occurring in hydraulic fracturing
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The main stages of constructing a model of fracture zone in producing formation, according to microseismic monitoring results, are considered in the paper.

articleTitle: Geoinformation technology for assesment of ecological risks
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper presents the results of experimental investigations of the original ecologically safe approach as related to the assessment of the geoecological risk from powerful mass explosions for the social and natural environment. In this approach, seismic vibrators are used as sources imitating explosions but having, in contrast to them, a much smaller power. Such sources can simultaneously excite in a medium seismic and acoustic (vibroseismoacoustic) oscillations with precision power and frequency-temporal characteristics.

articleTitle: Boundary Element Method for eddy current problem
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper is focused on electromagnetic field modeling and wireless transmission of electromagnetic energy by using the Boundary Element Method. Fundamental aspects considered in this work include a mathematical model, the view of tangential basis functions and the implementation of the singularity subtraction method. The aim of research is the numerical modeling of electromagnetic fields spawned by harmonic sources of current and the study of wireless transmission of energy. The objective of this paper is the implementation of the Boundary Element Method as one of the most numerically effective ways to solve the electromagnetic problem. The relevance of this work is the replacement of the conventional Finite Element Method (FEM) by the Boundary Element Method (BEM) or their combined use. To overcome this difficulty BEM is used because it needs a surface mesh only and does not need any volume meshes. Thus, it works with bounded and unbounded computational domains. But this method is designed only for piecewise constant material functions and can hardly be implemented to the problems with non-linear parameters. But this case is beyond this paper.

articleTitle: Optimization of the process of elimination of failures in the network at the National university of Mongolia
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article examines the methods of designing and modeling of processes functioning of human-machine systems (PF HMS), based on functional-structural theory HMS and the generalized structural method of prof. A.I. Gubinsky. Is presented an algorithm for the generation of series-parallel connection of operations with the additional constraints, algorithm for generation alternative process the functioning of human-machine systems on the basis of common goals operations, algorithm for generation parametric alternatives on the basis of template.

articleTitle: Research on distributions of chi-squared goodness-of-fit test statistic for parametric generalized proportional hazards models
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, the differences between the proportional hazards model (PH), Hsieh model, and simple cross-effect model (SCE) are discussed. We also consider the chi-squared goodness-of-fit test for these models in the case of censored data. The investigation of test statistic distributions is given.

articleTitle: Generalized frequency transformation for the networks on stepped nonuniform sections of transmission line
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The generalized frequency transformation is presented. It enables to transform the networks on lumped elements to the networks on stepped nonuniform sections of transmission line with arbitrary quantity and length of steps. Also, equal transformations for the networks on stepped nonuniform sections of transmission line are presented.

articleTitle: Vector prediction model to describe the signals of seismic sensors group
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Signals recorded by seismic sensors, formed by the superposition of seismic waves propagating in the ground by multipath paths. Therefore, they obey a Gaussian distribution, and spectral-correlation properties allow the use of Markov models based on recurrent linear prediction mechanism. Models of this type are used in various fields, such as processing of speech signals, sonar systems, as well as a good description of the properties of seismic signals. The fact that sensitive sensors in the system are at a relatively short distance from each other, resulting in mutual dependence of local signals using which can further improve the quality of prediction, thereby reducing the residual background level and, therefore, increase the signal-to-noise ratio. So in the work as an alternative to the existing local processing is offered jointly (vector) processing of signals observed in the group of seismic sensors. Furthermore, a method of identifying a model parameter vector prediction is described.

articleTitle: Two terminal circuits on nonuniform microstrip lines
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper we show a solution for self frequency spectrum constriction of two terminal circuits based on microstrip lines. The designed method is based on using nonuniform transmission lines and is approved by agreement between theoretical calculation and electromagnetic (EM) software simulations. A maximum frequency deviation between calculated results and EM simulation corresponds to 1.7 MHz only at gigahertz ranges and allows one to create a high frequency filter design with more than 40 dB wide stopband signal amplitude suppression.

articleTitle: Development of standard and measuring devices to determine the parameters of petroleum products
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article discusses the development of measuring the volume expansion coefficient.

articleTitle: Comparison of torque-speed-characteristic of Flux Switching Machines with Permanent Magnet excitation and hybrid excitation
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper a Flux Switching Permanent Magnet Machine (FSPM) and a Flux Switching Machine (FSM) with hybrid excitation (HE) are compared regarding their torque-speed characteristic. Different flux control strategies are implemented and the resulting torque-speed characteristic is discussed.

articleTitle: Application of finite element models for design of high-precision MEMS pressure sensors
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Finite element models of piezoresistive silicon pressure sensor with dielectric isolation as well as resonant pressure sensor (RPS) and optomechanical unit of photoelectric fiber-optical pressure sensor are presented in this paper. The models take into account various specific effects which are taking place while designing sensors with an overall error less than 0.5% with only passive elements. That type of sensors has a great interest for applications with a harsh environment conditions (high operation temperature and so on). It is demonstrated, that consideration of scaling effects for piezoresistive pressure sensors allows to increase sensor sensitivity and to compensate both full scale span and zero offset temperature dependence. Also the calculations of the RPS sensitivity with an actual shape of resonator and its junction region to elastic element are presented in this paper. A dependence of the pressure sensor resonant frequency on technological factors is established. It is shown, that a rational choice of optomechanical unit construction of photoelectric fiber-optical pressure sensor allows to gain 20% increase in amount of movement of optical fiber and, as a result, to increase sensitivity. An efficiency of finite element models is demonstrated on the existing pressure sensors samples.

articleTitle: Peculiarity of multi-splitting filtering technology
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper presents the review of basic results which described the optical properties of novel optical filter/multiplexer constructed by multiply coupled wave-guides. For the study, a modified effective index method (MEIM), has been used. It correctly describes, in the 2D case both the phase and the group indexes in a 3D silicon wire waveguide and makes it possible to simulate complicated SOI structures by 2D finite difference time domain method (FDTD). The silicon wire crossings are realized by means of a vertical up and down coupling through the silica buffer of tapered Si wires with the upper thick polymer waveguide. FDTD modeling prove that a short 0.26 mm multiplexer with 32 couplers has FSR 35 nm, spectral resolutions 1.4 nm, internal loss -0.7 dB and sidelobes -20 dB.

articleTitle: Influence of substrate surface morphology on growth CaF2 on Si (100) in low and high temperature modes
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The growth of CaF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> on Si (100) substrates of various qualities was studied for low and high temperature modes at an early growth stages. The growth of samples was carried out by MBE at growth temperature about ~5000°C (low temperature mode) and about ~7500°C (high temperature mode).. The surface morphology of the substrates and the grown structures was studied in semi contact mode with an ambient air Solver P47H NT-MDT atomic force microscope. It was found, that depending on the substrate surface morphology, either triangular shaped CaF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> islands are formed on Si (100) or rectangular shaped CaF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> islands are developed, leaving the most part of a substrate surface uncovered, for low temperature mode. While in high temperature mode on the both types of substrate rectangular shaped CaF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> islands are formed, covering the substrate almost uniformly. In low temperature mode a substrate surface morphology strongly influences morphology of CaF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> films defining formation of structure defects at an initial growth stage.

articleTitle: Error estimators of discreteness while gaging the RMS of periodic signals
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Therein under, the document covers the reasons of outliers' appearance upon the observation error function of discreteness when changing a sample rate in an analog-to-digital converter (ADC) which is used for measurement of the signal's root mean square (RMS). We evaluate an upper bound for measurement uncertainty of discreteness depending on a number of bits in the ADC.

articleTitle: Multi-frequency lasing of diode laser (795 nm) for pumping Rb frequency standard
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The purpose of this research is to analyze in detail some characteristics of diode laser for further using for pumping Rb frequency standard.

articleTitle: On formula for natural linewidth in distributed feedback lasers; simulation of experiments
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Formulas for natural linewidth in dimensional and non-dimensional forms for distributed feedback (DFB) lasers are derived on the basis of the formula for the line shape which has been derived in the process of applying effective nonlinear photorefractivity which is assumed. Corrugation, phase, and amplitude components of the natural linewidth are taken into account. We have defined characteristic parameters describing the natural linewidth of DFB lasers and found their numerical values by solving an inverse problem, and then have simulated experimental measurements represented in the literature. This development brings the subject of understanding and capability of calculating laser parameters, as well as simulating the natural linewidth of semiconductor lasers to a qualitatively new level.

articleTitle: Physico-chemical properties petroleum products with the addition of “NanoKOR-F”
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper presents the investigation results of influence reducing additives on the physicochemical properties of modified petroleum product.

articleTitle: Robust method analysis interferogram with distortion the profile of fringes
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The proposed modification of an interference signals' analysis method in PSI stable to a distortion of an interference fringes profile. In the proposed method a phase difference is measured between several selected points on an interference pattern. The method can be used for an analysis interferograms obtained in multipass interferometers.

articleTitle: Correlation analysis of interference in the electrical minerals prospecting system
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article is about the interference elimination in the electrical minerals prospecting system. The authors describe a new method of obtaining a mathematical model of the slow interference. This model is derived by using Yule-Walker linear prediction method of 8<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> order. Graphs are drawn for each stage of the algorithm: the plot of the signal in a rare time, the plot of the interpolated signal, linear prediction coefficients were found and the plot of the autocorrelation function of Yule-Walker linear prediction method were drawn. The experiment showed that this way of presenting the slow interference gives more accurate estimates of the autocorrelation function than previously used multivariate Gaussian distribution. The algorithm discussed in this paper will be used for filtering the received signal and reduction of the slow interference impact.

articleTitle: On formula for natural linewidth in Fabry-Perot lasers; simulation of experiments
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Formulas for natural linewidth in Fabry-Perot semiconductor lasers in dimensional and non-dimensional forms are derived on the basis of the formula for the line shape which has been deduced when applying nonlinear photorefractivity. Medium, phase, and amplitude components of the natural linewidth are taken into account. We define characteristic parameters describing the natural linewidth of Fabry-Perot semiconductor lasers, find their numerical values by solving an inverse problem, and then simulate all experimental measurements represented in the literature we have available; then non-dimensional natural linewidth is simulated. This development brings the subject of understanding physics and capability of calculating laser parameters, as well as simulating the natural linewidth of semiconductor lasers, to a qualitatively new level.

articleTitle: Thermal energy distribution on degrees of freedom
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The calculation method of average values of energy and degrees of impulse and coordinate projections of ideal classical gas particle is proposed for Hamiltonian with power argument dependences. The statistical integral of canonical distribution is used.

articleTitle: Variational ratiometric measuring comparator of impedance parameters MNS1200
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: There is considered the variational error correction of the basic units of ratiometric impedance meter. It is given the structure of the meter, which implements this method, implementation algorithms are described, measurement error is estimated. The results of experimental researches and basic metrological characteristics of established at the base meter MHC-1200 are given.

articleTitle: Stability analysis systems of the metrological providing and managements
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Expansion of scales of industrial automation, increase of requirements to accuracy of managerial decision-making need in improvement metrological support on production. To decide this task, appropriate mathematic models of metrological systems for production support and control are being elaborated.

articleTitle: Driver test chip development for power transistor management in AC/DC power supply units in Zero Voltage Switching mode
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Driver test chip for adaptive power transistors management has been developed for implementation in AC/DC power supply units with Zero Voltage Switching operation mode. Driver is dedicated for high-power, high-efficiency power supply units.

articleTitle: Interrelationship «structure-hardness-fusibility» for oxide crystals
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The indistinct interrelationship between the mel-ting temperature (T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub>), Mohs hardness (H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</sub>), thermal con-ductivity (k), and structure of many oxide synthetic crys-tals, and minerals has been established more detail. It is shown that the external boundary of the full set {H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</sub> - T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub>} is res-tricted with 7-side polygon. These data has been useful at search of the most hardness and heat-conducting materials for optoelectronic devices.

articleTitle: Quadrature components autocorrelation of signals from surface-distributed object reflectors density distribution function
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The analytic expression of quadrature components autocorrelation of signals from surface-distributed object reflectors density distribution function has been acquired and analyzed.

articleTitle: Identification of time series based on methods of singular spectrum analysis and modeleteka
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Singular spectrum analysis (SSA) is relatively new method for analysis of non-stationary time series. In this paper we propose to use variative modeling, based on joint use of SSA and method of modeleteka (models warehouse), for obtaining of analytical model of time series that combines adequacy, compactness, and interpretability. First, time series are decomposed into components using SSA; significant components are selected using formal indicators. Second, each significant component is identified according to the purpose of identification with simple and interpretable model from preformed modeleteka. The result is final model of time series in additive or additive-multiplicative form. Applicability of the method is illustrated on synthetic data.

articleTitle: An accuracy improve of amplitude- and phase-frequency characteristics of electrochemical impedance using discrete samples
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A corrected method of numerical determination of amplitude- and phase-frequency characteristics of electrochemical systems gotten by discrete electrical signals of impact and response and using Fourier transform is considered. It is proposed to restore first a continuous form of discrete signals using Lagrange polynomial spline before applying Fourier transform.

articleTitle: Development and research of reflectance pulse oximeter
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Pulse oximeters are used extensively in clinical practice. Reflectance oximeter is designed to determine arterial oxygen saturation. Oximeter of this type allows to measure anywhere in the body. Preliminary results indicate that the device has a good resolution and high reliability, and also allows to determine the pulse rate.

articleTitle: Analysis of adaptive equalization of tone-frequency channel method
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The adaptive equalization of characteristic of tone-frequency channel is analyzed. When analyzing the correction process on the basis of the impulse response used transition from the time domain to the frequency and backward.

articleTitle: Development of information system of innovation evaluation at the meso level
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper is considered on the problem of the evaluation of innovation at the meso level. Business processes, which is involved in the evaluation, is identified and described by CASE-tools. The results of evaluation of innovation of 82 Regions using the developed information system are listed.

articleTitle: Analysis of the radiation heating mechanisms of heterostructures during molecular beam epitaxy
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper considers the physical model of radiation heating of the heterostructures during molecular beam epitaxy‥ It is shown that the temperature of the heteroepitaxial semiconductor with a band gap smaller than that of the substrate increases with increasing of the film thickness. Mechanisms of the temperature change of the Ge/Si heterostructure depending on the film thickness Ge are proposed

articleTitle: Heuristic and statistical methods of complex data processing in minerals seismic and electrical exploration
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper considers heuristic and statistic methods of data processing minerals seismic and electrical exploration. The statistical method of seismic and geoelectric sections is the most preferable one to find nonuniformity of earth structure using maximal a posteriori probabilities.

articleTitle: The long-term assessment of the life quality, frequency of recurrence and continued growth in patients, operated on for the skull base meningiomas with the use of the neodymium laser
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The Problem of basal meningioma's surgical removal hasn't yet been solved and still is of great importance due to the development of intra- and postoperative complications and their frequent recurrence. All these factors influence the quality of patient's life. In the current study the frequency of recurrence and continued growth of tumors were analyzed, as well as the life quality of 83 patients operated on for basal meningiomas in the Novosibirsk Institute of Traumatology and Orthopedics from 1995 to 2008. Of 51 patients neodymium laser was used during meningiomas surgical removal. In 32 cases, the laser wasn't used and patients were operated with the use of modern methods of microsurgery. The use of the laser for surgical removal of basal meningiomas allowed to increase considerably the operation efficacy and reduce the risk of re-occurrence of tumors, and also led to a noticeable increase in the life quality of the patients before, after surgery and in a long-term period.

articleTitle: Dielectric Zoned Wedge Scanned Diffractive 3D lens antenna-radome
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The design of dielectric wedge-scanned millimeter wave lens antennas with measured results is presented. The diffractive lens antenna (DLA) is treated; it incorporates a lens that transforms the radiation pattern of a scalar feedhorn. A schematic diagram of a zoned dielectric wedge-scanned DLA with Fresnel spherical surface is presented. An efficient device for scanning the beam produced by a DLA is a zoned dielectric wedge. A pair of wedge produces an arbitrary scan pattern out to some maximum displacement from antenna boresight. It has been shown the scanned diffractive 3D antenna-radome allow to wide scan at least of 25 degree with no losses in gain.

articleTitle: The geometric properties of free motion the dynamical systems in the phase space
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Formulated the law of the curvature of the phase space with the free movement of dynamical systems. In addition to adopted in classical mechanics classification of motions in the state space as a translational motion of the center of mass and spinor motion around the center of mass in the phase space added classification spinor motion on the surface of a hypersphere and translational motion of the center offset hypersphere. We propose a new paradigm named L. Euler development of mathematical and scientific disciplines, born in the well known “dispute D'Alembert and L.Euler about the string”, namely: “forget about the equation, if the phenomenon is described is found the general solution rather than the equation”.

articleTitle: The basic circuit frequency correction basic dynamic parameters of sensors of physical quantities with the potential output
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper present a method of improving the performance of sensors of physical quantities with potential output, which have output parasitic capacitance. The practical scheme based on the introduction of the basic sensor schematic special circuit correction of dynamic parameters. The conditions of synthesis of correction circuits that compensate the influence of parasitic capacitance sensor on the operating frequency range of the sensor and the time of the establishment of the transitional process. Examined three options to build the chain of compensation, which are implemented on the basis of the followers of voltage and current.

articleTitle: Data transmission problem for modern data networks
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: We study the transmitting problem, relevant for all types of network - multicast messages. The algorithms for solving the problem with different models - a weighted graph and UDG-graph (intersection graph of the unit circle) are described.

articleTitle: Calculation of robust PID-controller
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper deals with a new approach to PID-controller parameter design that is based on the localization method. It is shown that controllers calculated by this method provide possibility to control system with non-linear and non-stationary plant. This paper includes numerical experiments with a set of linearized model of the super-heater. The main result is the methodology for parameter calculation.

articleTitle: Estimation of human psycho-emotional state using pictures of gas discharge on the skin surface at biologically active points
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Paper shows possibility to estimate human psycho-emotional state using pictures of high voltage gas discharge glow on the skin surface at biologically active points. The parameters of the glow pictures are determined. The results of preliminary clinical tests of the proposed method are presented.

articleTitle: Enterprises of the electronic industry: Challenges and possibilities for development
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the analysis of the enterprise challenges in the electronic industry. The systematic approach for the formation of three strategical targets of the activity of holding “Russian electronics” namely the general management, economical, and social targets as well as the application of the best methods of the successful corporate management, the harmonization of technical and personnel policy as well as the organization of the information disclosure of the enterprises for all interested parties are proposed.

articleTitle: Development of biotechnical complex for laser therapy
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this article, on the basis of studying of influence of several regimens of low-intensive laser radiation on bioobjects, the biotechnical complex is developed for laser therapy.

articleTitle: Protection of telecommunication systems from lightning via pin diverter
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this work is the analysis of the impedance of memory, shown by example for calculating the parameters of the terrestrial lightning rod, and defining the requirements for the underground part of the memory.

articleTitle: Dislocations and superconductivity in metallic monospirals at the room and positive temperatures
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The description of experimentally observed phenomenon of abnormally high electrical conductivity—“superconductivity” (SC) at the room and higher temperatures is represented. The effect was observed in metallic monospirals of small radius curvature with high density and regular distribution of dislocations. Transition into state of SC has been observed experimentally in the range from −50°C up to 3000°C at the density of transmitting current up to 2 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sup> A cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup>. The experimental data confirming the watched phenomenon are represented. The explanations of this phenomenon are being proposed in the framework of the dislocation model.

Author Keywords: the Velocity of Current Density Growth

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of methods of adaptation in the correction of the frequency characteristics of systems by the FIR filter
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The adaptive equalization of frequency characteristic of systems by the FIR filter is analyzed. Comparative results of application for the least squares method and sequential regression method are presented.

articleTitle: Smart wireless heat flux sensor
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article considers the development of smart wireless heat flux sensor with sensitive element fabricated by MEMS technology. The sensor is based on a microcontroller STM32W108 with a built-in radio transceiver module. The realization of the sensor network's prototype with `star' topology on the basis of the protocol Simple MAC is proposed.

articleTitle: Classification of multidimensional observation sequences described by Hidden Markov Models
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article analyses several approaches to classification of multidimensional observation sequences described by Hidden Markov Models. It demonstrates good efficiency of method based on HMM parameter derivatives when competing classes are close in some way.

articleTitle: Extreme electric loads at the ultra-thin films of the silicon oxide with inhomogeneous boundary
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The electrical connectivity limits of ion and electron conductivity processes in ultrathin dielectric of digital and analog devices at the approach extreme loads were estimated. Exceeding of critical electric fields, current, cumulative energy, mobile charge intensity with inhomogeneity in architecture were considered as conducted interference of dielectric films. The standards of quality parameters for dielectric films' conducted interference were set up: electric field intensity deviation from the critical value, temporary overvoltage, ion and energy overload.

Author Keywords: electron and ion conductivity of digital and analog devices
simulation of conductivity of silicon oxide with inhomogeneous boundary

articleTitle: Analysis and research of uncertainty of systems of metrological ensuring and management of production
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Any parameters have a relevant uncertainty in a real industrial process. Quality of measurements and quality of production are connected. If the quality of measurements does not satisfy requirements of technological process quality of the production is low.

articleTitle: The construction of probabilistic reliability model with one-shot device testing data
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, the parametric and nonparametric approaches to construction of probabilistic reliability model with one-shot device testing data are considered. Such data are referred to as current status data, which include right censored and left censored observations (no complete observations at all). Statistical properties of maximum likelihood estimates of distribution parameters have been investigated. The algorithm for nonparametric estimation of unknown distribution function for such kind of data has been proposed.

articleTitle: Hydroxyapatite ion-thermal processing in the vacuum
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The changes in the composition and morphology of the target surface of hydroxyapatite in the RF magnetron sputtering using electron microscopy, infrared spectroscopy and EDX-analysis. It was shown that during prolonged heat-treatment of ion composition and surface structure are stabilized.

articleTitle: Siberian Research Institute of Metrology. Stages of 70-year-old way and today tasks
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper presents the main results of the research and development carried out in the Siberian Research Institute of Metrology for 70 years of its existence. There is represented the history of the Institute, as well as tasks that are met by members of the Institute nowadays

articleTitle: Spatial concentration of objects as a factor in locally weighted models
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A new approach to construct of spatial econometric models is proposed. It involves the partitioning of objects into groups based on the spatial concentration by k-means clustering. The developed algorithm was compared with known algorithms of k-nearest neighbors and kernel smoothing with a rectangular weight function (kernel). Its significant advantage in running time was shown. The obtained results of computational experiments revealed that the prediction accuracy using the new algorithm yields k-nearest neighbors algorithm but it is about the same as kernel smoothing.

articleTitle: The thermal image correction in control of overheated zones of materials handled by microwave field
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: To determine the flash point of carbon-phosphate agent in microwave fields at processing is required to be not exceeded temperature 68 °C over the entire surface of the material being processed. The methods of correction of geometric noise with usage of one certificated thermal field and two not certificated fields are offered. These methods are simple for hardware representation and may be utilised for correction of thermovision map in real time, that is, directly during activity of thermovision device.

articleTitle: Analysis of dispersion decreasing methods of computer simulation results during solving applied research problems
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Annotation - In the article, analysis of dispersion decreasing methods of computer simulation results is fulfilled. Simulation is used for analysis a process of operation and preventive maintenance for the purpose of acquisition of output data which are acceptable for further research.

articleTitle: Maximum-likelihood-based method to estimate spectral line location parameter within gamma quanta energetic spectrum
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The method was supposed to obtain an effective estimation of spectral line location parameter within gamma quanta energetic spectrum. The method is based on numerical solving of an equations set obtained by the maximum likelihood method applied to sample data functional description. The numerical modeling was carried out to prove the efficiency of the method supposed. The invariance to the background radiation level was shown. This feature is provided by the background statistical nature taken into account in sample data functional description.

articleTitle: Analysis of the efficiency of methods for inputting the external information into radiation thermometers
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper deals with the simulation of error of non-contact temperature measurements in the presence of a number of external destabilizing factors. It is shown that the usage of standard correction procedure utilizing the “coefficient of emissivity” setting doesn't reduce the error to an acceptable level throughout the range. Two methods of an additional external correction are proposed and investigated.

articleTitle: Test Bench for a high performance PSM drive system for a nautical application
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: To substitute a conventional combustion engine in a nautical application for higher speeds a special designed PSM was developed and manufactured. The development of the new design was necessary, because the operating range of speed and torque are different from commercial machines for industrial applications. In addition, to deal with the unique requirements of an electric drive for use in a maritime high speed vessel, features like high power density, compact construction volume, light weighted structure, water cooling and high overload capacity were implemented. Because testing the drive system and measuring reliable data on water is very problematic, a Test Bench was established. To simulate realistic conditions within the complete projected operating range a Hydrodynamic Brake system was used as load machine. Using this method the high amount of breaking energy is transformed directly into heat in the water based cooling system of the Brake.

articleTitle: Effect of nonuniform carrier distribution on average resistivity: Case of polysilicon grains
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Grain boundaries of polycrystalline semiconductor film trap free carriers creating space charge regions. The length of the depleted regions depends on the trapping states density and free carriers concentration within the grains. As the carrier concentration within depletion region is lower the resistance there can is higher than in the rest of the grain. It is shown that the average concentration of free carriers and specific resistivity can be significantly different from that obtained for the case of uniform free carrier distribution in the grain.

articleTitle: Velocity factor of leaky-wave antenna based on partially filled rectangular waveguide
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A Leaky-wave antenna based on a covered rectangular waveguide with partially dielectric filling and transverse slots is investigated. The complex propagation constant is defined by matching of magnetic field in slots. A velocity factor dependences on the waveguide filling parameters are presented. The influence of the dielectric position in the waveguide on the antenna characteristics is considered. The radiation pattern is analyzed. A pattern tilt angle, an optimal antenna length and a first null beamwidth are defined.

articleTitle: Mathematical modeling of single-phase thermal control system of the spacecraft
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article discusses the modeling of heat transfer in elementary contour-phase thermal control system. Calculated relations to characterize the circuit are given. Results of calculation are described. Problems and prospects of mathematical modeling of systems of spacecraft thermal control are evaluated.

articleTitle: High-performance lawn-mower prototype with re-used Lithium Iron Phosphate battery
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Small lawn-mowers powered by low-energy lithium batteries are on the market already. However, battery powers only the grass cutting blades while propulsion is to be done manually. Standard self-propelling lawn-mowers use noisy combustion engines or 230 V AC supplied single-phase induction machines. A self-propelled battery powered lawn-mower is developed and assembled within a prototype project. Lithium Ion batteries are the present optimal choice for mobile power from the technical side. The general high cost of such an mobile off-grid energy supply leads to employing cells in re-use. An application-adapted battery management system is realized for that purpose. As the 230 V AC drive is the original grid-powered one, we insert a commercial 12 V DC => 230 V AC inverter. In order to accomplish start-up of the induction machine some additional circuits are included.

articleTitle: Method of calculation of characteristics of shielding of objects at influence of the polyharmonic electromagnetic fields
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: On the basis of the solution of the equations of Maxwell the method of calculation of level of shielding of objects is considered at impact on them polyharmonic electromagnetic hindrances.

articleTitle: State verification schedule for means of measurement of electrical quality factor in the frequency range from 10 Hz to 300 MHz
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: There are metrological characteristics of the state primary standard unit of electric quality factor and transmission unit circuit quality factor from it to the secondary and working standards of quality factor, as well as working means of this parameter.

articleTitle: Influence of diffraction divergence and wavefront curvature of the Gaussian beam on the error of length measurement
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: We have carried out investigation of the interference pattern that occurs during the passage of a Gaussian beam through a Michelson interferometer. This allowed finding the length measurement error due to diffraction divergence and wavefront curvature of the light beam. Conditions under which these errors are minimal were found.

articleTitle: Study of RHEED intensity oscillations during the heteroepitaxial growth of CaF2 on Si(111)
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The results of investigations of the nucleation mechanisms and growth of the CaF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/Si(111) heterostructures by reflection high-energy electron diffraction (RHEED) are presented. It is shown that preliminary growth of the 2D silicon buffer layer provides two-dimensional layer-by-layer growth of subsequent layers of CaF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. The possible reasons of the 2D layer-by-layer growth failure at high substrate temperatures are proposed.

articleTitle: Modified effective index method to fit the phase and group index in 3D photonic wire waveguide
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A modified effective index method (MEIM), which correctly describes, in a 2D case, both the phase and the group indexes in a 3D photonic wire, is discussed in the paper. MEIM utilizes the combined index profile with two spatial parameters. A central part has a wire index and a width of a nearly wire height. A basic part has a width of 3D wire and a fitting index Nb. Numerical experiments by FDTD of Ring resonator and multi-splitting multiplexer, Fabry-Perot and asymmetric Mach-Zehnder interferometers constructed by silicon wires prove that the MEIM gives an excellent agreement (about 2%) with test 3D simulation in comparison with an about 30%-45% error for EIM. MEIM is preferable for simulation of SOI filtering structures by 2D FDTD.

articleTitle: Effective tensor characteristics for heterogeneous media
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A numerical method for computing effective electric characteristics of heterogeneous media is proposed in this paper. We analyze relation between effective characteristics and interior structure of complex medium like form and location of the inclusions. The computed results of the direct problem with inclusions are compared with the results of the direct problem without inclusions. The problem without inclusions is considered as a problem for anisotropic medium with computed tensor characteristics.

articleTitle: Structuring of a set of objects in distributed computer system based on cluster allocation
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The proposed method is aimed to solve the problem of structuring a set of objects of a distributed computer system and it's representation as a composition of subsets. A weighted ordinary graph is used as a model of the system. To solve the problem, the authors propose the use of the effect of separation of vertices into individual clusters, which can be observed when displaying a set of compact subgraphs at a graph. A concept of compact subgraphs and an algorithm for their formation is introduced. The solution of the structuring problem is illustrated by the example of a weighted graph.

articleTitle: Device for regulating the temperature of the power transistors during the test
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article discusses a device for temperature control of semiconductor devices used in determining their heat-sensitive and electrical characteristics and parameters. To regulate and stabilize the temperature of semiconductor device used Peltier elements.

articleTitle: Algorithmic ways to improve the precise and reliability of the time-frequency definitions for GNSS technologies
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper shows the relevance of the algorithmic approach to improve the precise of time-frequency GNSS technology definitions. There is considered the realization of this approach for the control of airborne time scales, spatially separated hours syncs and group time scales formation.

articleTitle: A functional verification system of IP-blocks in network protocols
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The functional verification problem of IP blocks of network protocols controllers is considered. The application of the verification method using fully-functional models of the processor and the internal bus of a system-on-chip is justified. Principles of construction of a verification system based on the given approach are proposed. As an example, the verification of IP block of RMAP-protocol controller of SpaceWire network is presented.

articleTitle: Multilevel pulse-width two-forked regulators of a direct current on the basis of condenser DC-DC converters of resonant type
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In article principles of construction and work multilevel two-forked pulse-width regulators of a direct current on the basis of condenser DC-DC converters of resonant type are considered. Regulators differ in the raised efficiency in low factor of harmonics of an entrance and target current and improved dimensions and weight parametres. Effect will reach use multilevel and multicycle a work principle, and as soft switching of all transistor keys a part of a power chain of a regulator.

Author Keywords: multilevel two-forked pulse-width regulators of a direct current
multicycle the resonant converter on the basis of structures with switched condensers

articleTitle: Spectral properties of 3D diffractive lenses with 3D subwavelength focusing spot
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The innovative radiating structures as a conical millimeter wave FZP lens are proposed for subwave-length focusing at different wavelength. The results of experimental verification are discussed. It has been shown that in contrast to the flat diffractive optics the curvilinear 3D diffractive conical optics allows for over-coming 3D Abbe barrier at the bandwidth at least of ±20% with focal distance F more than F>40λ. The focal intensity distribution for such type of lenses is not circularly symmetric and thus the focal spot in the high numerical aperture case is no longer an Airy pattern. These results may find useful applications in optical microscopes, including “reverse-microscope”, nondestructive testing, microoptics, and nanooptics.

articleTitle: Informational component of returned ultra wideband probing signal
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article observes the mechanism of induction of transient processes in an object of ultra wideband probing and suggests a method of evaluation of the time elapsed to reach harmonic phase of probing signal. The article also provides calculated data of phase change over time.

articleTitle: Development and investigation of digital auscultometer
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article describes the development and investigation of the digital auscultometer. The results of studies of the characteristics show that the device has important properties such as informational content, high resolution and speed of analysis.

articleTitle: The use of particle filtering for detecting a high maneuvering target
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper shows that the performance of particle filter track-before-detect algorithms significantly degrades if they do not consider high maneuverability of the target. We propose the track-before-detect algorithm that takes into account accelerating a target during integration time. Receiver operating characteristics for various parameters show the efficiency of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Analysis of process of adaptation during the identification of FIR and IIR filters by the least squares method
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The identification of unknown system by the least squares method is analyzed. The comparative results for the identification of the IIR and FIR filter are presented.

articleTitle: Fault tolerance analysis of autonomous network nodes
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Fault tolerance of modern networks becomes one of the important issues of telecommunication industry. In this paper we consider the networks, which contain smart autonomous nodes. A mathematical model for performance analysis of the considered networks is offered. A counteraction technique against intrusion is discussed as well.

articleTitle: About systematization standards in information technology
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: An approach to the systematization of standards information technology (IT) processes based on the software life cycle.

articleTitle: A new optical nanoinclusions detection method in transparent media
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The influence of nanoninclusions on realization precisions and sensitivities of a recently developed new approach in anisotropic (single-axis) crystals investigation is considered. It is proved in the work that one of the important experimental realization conditions of the developed approach is when ellipsometric reflection systems parameters are Ψ = π/4 H Δ = π/2. It is proposed to choose Si-SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> -type structures (silicon dioxide or silicon nitride film on silicon surface), which are isotropic and homogeneous, as a reflection system. It is shown that the precision and sensitivity of this approach considerably depends on the presence of nanoinclusions in the media under study.

articleTitle: Treatment of malignant tumors with electrochemotherapy
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A layout of the device for the treatment of malignant tumors with electroporation is developed. Investigation of the device characteristics is conducted. Animal model studies have confirmed the efficacy of the device.

articleTitle: Experimental researches of flash temperature of petroleum products
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper presents the results of investigations of the temperature distribution of petroleum product at different heating rates in the test crucible analyzer SIM 5.

articleTitle: On laser spectroscopy resolution
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The laser spectrometer resolution under conditions of continuous and pulse laser radiation is considered. At generation of ultrashort laser pulses the spectrometer resolution is low, being a function of the laser pulse length. On the contrary, the temporal resolution of ultrashort pulses increases as the pulse length decreases.

articleTitle: Dispersion of the group velocity direction of surface acoustic waves in layered structures
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The dispersion of an angle between the phase velocity and the group velocity of surface acoustic waves (SAW) in layered structures ZnO[001]/Sapphire[001], AlN[001]/Sapphire[001] and InSb[001]/Y+128°LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> was studied. It was shown that this dispersion can achieve 30° in the frequency band of 500 MHz.

articleTitle: Argumentation of the enhancement of functional capabilities of bridge circuits
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article gives the argumentation for the enhancement of functional capabilities of bridge circuits with pulse power based on the analysis of four-terminal networks.

articleTitle: Controllable DC power exchange systems based on switching capacitors
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Design principles of pulse-amplitude (PAM) and pulse-width (PWM) modulation controllable systems for two-level direct current (DC) power exchange systems (PES) based on structures with switching capacitors are considered. The universal structure of a controllable PES not requiring additional regulating elements is proposed. It is shown that the efficiency factor of the controllable PES (PAM) depends only on the levels of input and output voltages and does not change during regulation. The regulating characteristics are obtained and PES (PAM and PWM) transistor switches control algorthms are developed and illustrated by corresponding control matrices.

Author Keywords: bidirectional structures based on switching capacitors
pulse-amplitude and pulse-width bidirectional DC regulators

articleTitle: Controller design for testbed of strength tests based on time-scale-separation method
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Controller design problem for testbed of strength test for aviation builds is discussed. The description of the stand equipped by electrohydraulic drive is presented. Results of experimental researches of dynamical characteristics for the stand are shown and, as the result, the mathematical model of the given stand has been received by results of experimental tests. Proportional-integral (PI) controller is designed for force interaction via singular perturbation technique such that multi-time-scale motions are artificially induced in the closed-loop system. Multi-time-scale motions analysis allows getting analytical expressions for selection of controller parameters. Experimental results are presented.

articleTitle: DC motor control on the base of new relay algorithm
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The new control algorithms for wide class of electromechanical systems are proposed on the base of discontinuous control in the paper. The designed vortex algorithms provide full invariance of the closed loop system with respect to unmeasured unmatched disturbances. The efficiency of the proposed algorithms is demonstrated on the base of DC motor control.

articleTitle: SM-MIMO effect on the performance of LTE detectors in uncertain noise environments
publicationTitle: 2014 12th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The effect of Spatial Multiplexing - Multiple Input Multiple Output (SM-MIMO) transmission technique on the performance of commonly used 4G-LTE detection techniques, was investigated. The channel environments used are Additive White Gaussian (AWGN), noise and heavy-tailed noise distributions as an actual noise distribution. The detectors characteristics were obtained by computer simulation for the case of un coded QPSK modulation, and open loop spatial multiplexing.
